description: Shared Renovate config of the homelab repos (infrastructure, smart-home, private-cloud, homelab-engineering). Extend it with github>TheRealArthurDent/renovate:homelab; repo-specific rules stay in the repo's renovate.json.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions: minor, patch, pin and digest updates in one PR, merged by GitHub auto-merge once the required checks pass. The rulesets require a PR for main, so a branch automerge can't push there.
GitHub Actions majors: a PR each, merged by hand.

pre-commit hooks: minor, patch, pin and digest updates in one weekly PR, merged by GitHub auto-merge once the required checks pass. renovatebot/pre-commit-hooks alone releases almost daily. The ansible-lint hook is left out: it goes with the pip packages in the repos' ansible-devtools group.
